title: Endline vocabulary in context
instructions: Choose the meaning that best fits each independent sentence. Complete all five before submitting the protected form.

parts.prompt: Lina was diligent about the application: she worked on it every evening and did not stop until each section was complete. What does “diligent” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: Working every evening until it is finished shows steady effort.
choice_rationales.D: Her feelings about the result are not stated.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Diligent means working steadily and carefully.

parts.prompt: The new teacher was lenient about late homework: she accepted it without a penalty and simply reminded the class of the date. What does “lenient” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: Details are not the point of the sentence.
choice_rationales.C: Accepting late work without a penalty is not strict.
choice_rationales.D: She reminds the class of the date, so she knows it.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Lenient means less strict than others might be.

parts.prompt: Building a full bridge was too costly, but engineers said that repairing the existing footpath was feasible within the available budget. What does “feasible” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.A: Attention is not the decision criterion.
choice_rationales.B: Safety and temporary use are not stated.
choice_rationales.C: The repair can be completed within the budget.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Feasible means capable of being done successfully in the circumstances.

parts.prompt: Membership dwindled during the year: twenty students joined in January, twelve stayed until June and only five remained in December. What does “dwindled” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.B: Twenty, then twelve, then five shows a slow fall.
choice_rationales.D: The number falls, so it does not grow at all.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.

parts.prompt: To remain impartial, the judge scored the anonymous designs without being told which school had submitted each one. What does “impartial” most nearly mean?

choice_rationales.B: Anonymity prevents preference for a school.
choice_rationales.C: The rules are not in doubt.
choice_rationales.D: The judge evaluates rather than submits.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Impartial means fair and not favouring one person or group.
